description: This Java source file defines the class SmwSelectionTableModel, which is a table model used in the Android SDK wizard for managing package selection, including local and remote packages, with UI components for editing and rendering table cells.

classes.name: SmwSelectionTableModel
classes.description: A table model for managing package selection in the Android SDK wizard, supporting local and remote packages, with UI editing capabilities and SDK state linkage.

classes.name: SmwSelectionTableModel.LabelColumnInfo
classes.description: A column info class for displaying labels with action prefixes in the selection table.

classes.name: SmwSelectionTableModel.InstallColumnInfo
classes.description: A column info class for toggling installation status of packages with checkbox UI.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in the table, corresponding to the number of package descriptions.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table.

methods.name: getColumnInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the ColumnInfo object for a given column index.

methods.name: getObjectAt
methods.description: Returns the package description object at a specified row.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Gets the value for a cell at specified row and column.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Determines if a cell is editable based on its column and row.

methods.name: setValueAt
methods.description: Sets the value of a cell and updates the table.

methods.name: linkToSdkState
methods.description: Links the table model to an SDK state, updating data when SDK changes occur.

methods.name: resetTable
methods.description: Resets the table data based on the current SDK state.

methods.name: computeAction
methods.description: Computes the action (install, update, remove, keep) for a package description.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a list of actions to perform based on user selections.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Marks the model as disposed to prevent further updates.
